notes: Summary: Retail marketplace selling vertical apparel + accessories. Focus this year: improving on-site conversion via semantic search + reranking for promotional merchandising.
Catalog size: ~8M SKUs (multiple locales). Active product shards by region: NA (3.2M), EU (2.6M), APAC (2.2M). Expect Q4 seasonal spike x4-5 peak traffic.

Primary ask: Embeddings index + lightweight reranker to improve top-10 precision while keeping per-query cost within $0.003 target. Current baseline (Elastic + heuristic boosts) CTR down 6% vs target.

Performance targets: p95 front-end search latency <= 120ms (including embedding lookup + rerank), p99 degradation acceptable with fallback policy. Throughput target: 600 qps sustained in NA during promo windows.
Indexing cadence: nightly delta + hourly hot-updates for promoted SKUs. Expected daily index writes: ~120k vectors/day. Warm cache strategy desired for promo landing pages.
POC plan: build embeddings index of 1M canonical SKUs -> then scale to full 8M. Measure memory footprint, single-node vs sharded latency, cost per token/embedding. POC milestone due 2026-03-31.

Security/compliance: EU SKU residency required for price-sensitive items. Legal: no plaintext customer PII to leave VPC. Must support KMS + audit logs + SAML SSO. InfoSec questionnaire sent 2026-02-20 (drive link).

Architecture preferences: prefer model routing to cheaper quantized variants for tail requests, autoscale burst capacity for flash sales, automatic fallback to high-recall model if latency SLO at risk.
Quotes from call: 'We need consistent economics at scale — a tiny delta in cost per query multiplies in Q4.' — Head of Search (A. Moreno).
